description: FindIP searches patents by meaning, not just keywords. Describe a problem, a solution, or a technology in plain language and get the most relevant patents across the US, China, Japan, Korea, and Europe. Explore filing trends, drill into specific sections and claims, and analyze the patent landscape — all from the conversation.
